column1: # D3DDevice struct field offsets for Jet Set Radio Future (US), XDK D3D8 build 4134.
# Produced 2026-09-21. Every value below was DERIVED FROM THIS TITLE'S OWN default.xbe.
# No value is copied from another XDK version.
# XBE: ~/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Jet Set Radio Future/Jet Set Radio Future (US)/default.xbe
# Device pointer global: D3D8__D3D_g_pDevice = 0x0019DCE0 (the device struct address is *that*).
# All offsets are byte offsets from the start of the D3DDevice struct.
#                   the library's own OOVPA signature scan derived the value out of this XBE.
#   xbsdb-stock     Emitted by the stock, unpatched XbSymbolDatabase CLI (run of 20 Sep 2026).
#   disasm          Hand disassembly of this XBE (capstone, x86-32) at a named D3D8 function.
#   xref-replay     XbSymbolDatabase's own XREF_ENTRY byte offset applied by hand to this XBE:
#                   read the little-endian dword at (function address + XREF_ENTRY offset).

NOT emitted by the patched CLI because D3DDevice_SetPalette/GetPalette are not linked into JSRF at all (zero Palette symbols in the scan), so no OOVPA could derive it. Derived instead from the device teardown loop at 0x00192644: lea edi,[esi+0xA88]; mov ebx,4; each iteration releases [edi-0x10] (= m_Textures[i]) and [edi] (= m_Palettes[i]), i.e. the two 4-entry arrays sit exactly 0x10 apart.
